About

A raw, dynamic performer with honest songwriting written for the stage. Sincere lyrics sit over tight, melodic grooves. Her band is unconventional for soul: up to nine gospel backing vocalists make for live shows people talk about.

Highlights

  • Live line-up of up to nine gospel backing vocalists
  • Known for unusual vocal arrangements in a soul setting
